sources.snippet: Clinical RAG Safety Gateway Baseline Model Model Description This repository contains a small, transparent prototype model for Clinical assistants need retrieval, source attribution, and explicit abstention before answers reach care teams. The model combines per-label token weights with IDF-weighted evidence retrieval.
